RGAA 12.6.1: the header, main navigation, main content, footer and search areas each need a landmark, a heading that says what they hold, a button to hide them, a skip link before them, or a quick-access link to them. Areas are found from their landmark or from a name such as header or footer; since which blocks are areas is a person's call, an area without a landmark is asked about, never failed.
